blocks.text: SEOUL, South Korea (AP) — South Korea scrambled fighter jets Tuesday, November 24 to chase away Russian military aircraft that flew inside the country’s air defense identification zone over waters between the Korean Peninsula and Japan, Seoul’s military said. It corrected earlier government statements that the planes had violated the country’s territorial airspace. An alert for an eastern island was quickly lifted. The Joint Chiefs of Staff’s announcement followed a statement by the Ministry of the Interior and Safety, which relays military information for such public alerts, that Russian aircraft had violated South Korean airspace.
